title: Alaska's salmon-feasting bears face off in biggest Fat Bear Week ever
content: This year's single-elimination tournament will see 16 competitors face off, compared to 12 in past years. Officials report more cubs in Katmai National Park than they've seen in recent memory.

title: Trump says he is banning CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House
content: The president chalked the ban up to what he called unfavorable coverage, and he threatened that bans on other media companies could be coming.

title: When Trump and Xi meet they will discuss AI. 'Track Two' talks are already buzzing
content: An informal network of dialogues at think tanks and universities is bringing together experts from the U.S. and China to talk about the shared perils of AI — and possible paths forward.

title: Syrian regime planned American journalist's kidnapping for weeks
content: New reporting finds the abduction of journalist Austin Tice was planned by the Syrian government for weeks.

title: What expensive sulfur means for your dinner table
content: Oil supplies are falling, sulfur prices are threatening food costs, and we measure Lego against Hollywood

title: Will even one of the U.N.'s 17 'sustainable development goals' be met by 2030?
content: The 17 goals agreed upon by world leaders are incredibly ambitious. Are we even close to achieving any of them? If we don't, is the project a failure?

title: Judge says Trump can't demolish Kennedy Center. And, lawsuits target voter intimidation
content: A federal judge ruled yesterday that President Trump cannot tear down the Kennedy Center without a 30-day notice. And, recent lawsuits seek to keep armed federal officers away from polling sites.

title: Ms. Rachel has entered her album era, and she is so happy about it
content: Ms. Rachel has conquered YouTube, Netflix and the toy aisle. Now she's making an album, with real instruments, big feelings and her littlest listeners in mind.

title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
content: Warren Buffett is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after serving in the role for more than 50 years. His son, Howard, will become Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman

title: South Africa 'feels like a prison' for women amid spate of femicides
content: South Africa has some of the highest rates of violence against women in the world, and a spate of killings of nine women in the same area in recent weeks has led to renewed outrage.
